MIT; AOCI-CODE binary not bundled.

repos.name: wqzhellohhwy/dsh-thinking-language
repos.description: 锁定 DeepSeek Harness 模型用哪种语言思考——向 system 提示词注入一段语言约束。默认简体中文，可配置为任意语言。

repos.name: ButterHost69/dsh-mermaid-diagram
repos.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: a Mermaid diagram tool for the model, rendered as a diagram card in the Web UI.

repos.name: DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle
repos.description: One-click enable/disable switch for every model provider in DeepSeek Harness - disabled providers leave the model picker. DSH 模型提供商一键开关：在「设置 → 模型」每行「编辑」左侧放一个开关，关掉即从模型选择栏消失。

repos.name: SOH4C4759/dsh-plugin-cicd
repos.description: 发布台 (Release Console) for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry and a main-panel page showing each repository's latest CI run, its releases, and whether the local checkout is ahead of the release — with one-click build / release / publish-draft. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI and stores no credential.

repos.name: ThatSimpleTech/dsh-airlock
repos.description: Run DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on macOS inside a kernel sandbox, with every DeepSeek upload removed and Brave, Tavily or SearXNG search instead

repos.name: Fourteenth-Night/dsh-web-search-multi
repos.description: Unified multi-engine web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one plugin, three engines (Exa / Tavily / Firecrawl), three model-facing tools (web_search_exa / web_search_tavily / web_search_firecrawl) — AI picks the engine per query.

repos.name: DeepseekDays/dsh-ofm-model-manager
repos.description: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness — disabled models leave the model picker, custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences live in the profile and apply immediately.

repos.name: Colin900726/dsh-lan-web-access
repos.description: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的局域网 Web 访问插件 —— 在局域网或异地组网（如 Tailscale）环境里，让多台设备用浏览器同时访问同一台 dsh 主机

repos.name: oqozzzz/dsh-rail-tones
repos.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的会话导航条上竖向划过 / 按住拖动 / 点击刻度 / 滚轮翻阅时，按会话位置播放五声音阶提示音；只读观察 DOM，零依赖、零构建。
